intestazione: Cluster 1 – Forested volcanic periphery with low human presence: exceptions and internal tensions

eccezioni.testo: Forest cover reduces the legibility of the landmark.
The historic system dominates locally but remains episodic.

eccezioni.titolo: Very legible local presence of water
eccezioni.testo: A clearly visible but confined stream.
Small agricultural openings within the forest matrix.

nota: The exceptions are local and do not redefine the central structure of the cluster, which remains forested and peripheral to the volcano.
